note: Family-run RV park with cabins, tent sites and a banquet hall right off I-80 Exit 259 at West Liberty, beside a truck stop with gas and a convenience store; swimming pool and playground. A handy interstate overnight stop. No website of its own (Facebook page only); book by phone, pay on arrival. CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $40 a night in 2026 (RV Life and Campendium, May and October 2026 stays), $36 in 2025. --Claude
summary: Operator has a Facebook page only, no posted rate. Showers added to facilities, seasonal confirmed (closed for the season Nov 1, 2026). Camper-reported $36-40 stands, corroborated by five RV Life October 2026 stays at $40. Passes the gate.
flags: GATE FACTS (private): no operator-posted rate (Facebook page lists 'Price Range $$' only); camper reports: RV Life five stays in October 2026 at $40 a night (one with a KOA discount), Campendium $40 in May and October 2026 and $36 in June 2025, all under US$50. Not a Good Sam Park (stored good_sam false from the GS directory; military true from the same directory left as is). No gateway within 40 km; the family has not stayed. Fees left as stored (camper-reported, operator has no web page of its own).

PRESENCE: active Facebook page (1.7K followers, 'CLOSED FOR THE SEASON' posted November 1, 2026; '98% recommend (207 reviews)'), phone (319) 627-2676 matches stored and Google. Google Maps 4.7 (326 reviews); RV Life 4.5 stars, $$ (avg_rate 35), October 2026 ratings 8, 10, 6, 8, 10. One 10/2026 reviewer: 'Now rundown muddy unlevel sites ... obviously lacking maintenance'.

LONG-STAY: all five RV Life reviews are overnight transient stays (sites 4, 13, 29, pull-throughs, 'Reservation was by phone only'); the operator advertises RV, tent and cabin camping. On imagery the south and west edge rows hold what look like long-parked trailers and mobile homes (~15 units), but the pull-through rows inside the loop are transient. Read as a transient park with a seasonal side, not mostly seasonal; passes.
